args: $envFile = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'env/.env.prod'; Get-Content $envFile | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^\s*#' -or $_ -match '^\s*$') { return }; if ($_ -match '^\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(.*)\s*$') { $name = $matches[1]; $value = $matches[2].Trim(); if (($value.StartsWith('"') -and $value.EndsWith('"')) -or ($value.StartsWith("'") -and $value.EndsWith("'"))) { $value = $value.Substring(1, $value.Length - 2) }; [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($name, $value, 'Process') } }; uvx mcp-atlassian
